desc: 男童外穿提耳圆领短袖，竹节纹理织面，多彩色板一屏看全
leaf: 男童提耳圆领竹节纹理短袖T恤
name: 男童提耳领竹节纹理短袖衫款

shots.intent: 搜索列表里用去人台挂拍打单选点击，证明是一件外穿短袖衫而不是贴身衣，主图干净合规。
主图一秒法则：在首屏用平面天空底与手绘笔刷色带把夏日外穿这个头号卖点一秒讲完，同时靠颈部以下裁切规避童模面容。
shots.textZone: upper-left headline field above the shoulder line, one subline slot directly beneath it

shots.intent: 放大夏天外穿短袖最真实的两个麻烦：织面塌下来贴在身上、领口被汗浸软走形，让家长在右屏看到这件的解法。
shots.textZone: one blank label slot centred under each panel

shots.intent: 让家长代入孩子夏天出门上学的状态，用低机位仰角把衣长、袖长与宽松量一次看清。
用织纹微距解释这件看起来就不闷：竹节纱粒、双针车线与包边接缝的真实质感替家长回答手感与挺度问题。
shots.textZone: one blank caption slot at the lower left on a small cloud plate inset

shots.intent: 一屏看全整件的全部配色，扇形俯铺加色标条让选色选码一步完成，降低选错退换。
shots.textZone: one blank chip slot above each folded piece

shots.intent: 两处做工实拍级特写替家长回答磨不磨脖子、下摆会不会卷边这类穿着体感问题。
shots.textZone: one blank label slot centred under each of the two panels

shots.intent: 用背影补上后片观感与活动量，这是外穿决策的最后一块想象空间，同时面容完全不入镜。
把商品信息栏、三档指数行与尺码表结构化成一张账表，消掉偏大偏小厚不厚的最后疑虑，数值全部留给卖家实填。
shots.textZone: headline slot above the ledger, two blank value slots inside the ledger

shots.intent: 收掉风险：用六格护理图标栏与空白洗标给出可核对的做工与护理感，资质位一律留空由卖家实填。
shots.textZone: one headline slot above the rail and six blank label slots beneath the six glyphs

shots.intent: 详情页最后一步收口：叠装加按钮把逛完的配色与细节转成下单动作，笔刷色带承担标题场。
shots.textZone: headline slot inside the marigold band, one rounded button slot below it

style.backgroundSystem: seamless cloud-white plate #F5FAFC for packshots, variant boards and information sheets; one flat sky field #7FB6D9 for the opening poster, the walking scene and the closing screen; mist panel #E4EEF4 for mechanism screens and the painted studio slab; the garment's own fabric face at deep sky #5E93B4 fills the frame on texture macros; mist #E4EEF4 and deep sky #5E93B4 are the only permitted steps of the sky hue and no other tint may enter; one hand-painted dry-brush band #FFCB3D and one hairline rule in #22323C are the only decorative devices; never a gradient, never a real location, never a new hue
style.direction: cool children's daywear commerce, flat sky-field poster staging with dry-brush colour bands and blank-cell infographic discipline
style.iconSystem: one six-cell rail of single-weight line glyphs in #22323C, glyph only with every label slot left blank; one blank square chapter tab pinned to the right edge; no filled badges, no seal realism, no sticker shapes and no certificate artwork
style.lightingSystem: daylight-cool 6500K softbox key from the upper left in every screen, bounce fill on the shadow side, one soft grounded contact shadow under each hem so nothing floats, raking light reserved for the two fabric texture screens, no harsh speculars, no warm cast, no rim flash
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool children's daywear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cloud-white plate #F5FAFC, flat sky field #7FB6D9, one hand-painted dry-brush marigold band #FFCB3D and slate-ink label colour #22323C, with mist #E4EEF4 and deep sky #5E93B4 as the only permitted steps of the same sky hue; daylight-cool 6500K softbox key from the upper left, bounce fill on the shadow side and one soft grounded contact shadow under every hem, no harsh speculars and no warm cast; one modern geometric sans-serif plus one heavy poster grotesque used only on the two headline screens, in-image Chinese always as a placeholder slot and never as copied source wording, no rendered numerals at all; background system limited to cloud plate #F5FAFC, flat sky field #7FB6D9, mist panel #E4EEF4 and the garment's own fabric face at deep sky #5E93B4, with one dry-brush colour band and one hairline ink rule as the only decorative devices, never a gradient and never a new hue; layout system of unnumbered mosaic cells, one blank square chapter tab at the right edge, a six-cell blank-label icon rail and blank ledger grids where every value cell and every indicator cell stays empty; surface system of matte cloud plate #F5FAFC, mist panel #E4EEF4 and one long low painted studio slab, no wood, no rattan, no asphalt and no concrete; single-weight line glyph icons in #22323C only; the single top keeps a stable slight three-quarter front attitude and scale, every worn frame cropped from the neck down or shot from behind so no child face appears, and the taped neckline, back-neck tab, twin-needle hem and small left-chest mark zone are described structurally and never redrawn; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no color palette changes and no new accent hue beyond the single dry-brush marigold spot #FFCB3D
no mixed fonts, no serif, no handwritten or brush-set lettering and no oversized wall word
no random backgrounds, no real outdoor scenery and no stock location texture between screens
no inconsistent lighting direction and no missing contact shadow under the hems
no mismatched icon styles and no invented badge, seal or certificate artwork
no child face, no teen or adult proportions, no adult styling and no invented body shape on the garment
no redrawn chest mark, no duplicated print panel and no rendered numeral, letter or year anywhere in frame
style.presentationRules: the single top always reads at the same scale and the same slight three-quarter front attitude across screens; every worn frame is cropped from the neck down or shot from behind so no child face ever appears; the taped round neckline with its small back-neck tab, the twin-needle hem band, the sleeve opening and the small left-chest mark zone are named structurally and never redrawn; zero-prop staging so nothing overlaps or hides the garment; silhouettes fully visible on light screens, mid-shot crop allowed on mechanism and spec screens
style.surfaceSystem: matte cloud plate #F5FAFC, mist panel #E4EEF4 and one long low painted platform slab #E4EEF4 built in studio; no wood, no rattan, no asphalt, no concrete, no shell or sand; garment surfaces stay flat and unwrinkled with no lint
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif for every label plus one heavy poster grotesque used only on the two headline screens; no serif, no handwritten or brush-set typefaces and no retro lettering; in-image Chinese always appears as a placeholder slot, never as copied source wording; headline 28-44pt, subline 16-20pt, label 10-14pt, per-screen copy budget under 40 characters, no numerals rendered anywhere
